ValidationRule.description: This validation will restrict users to create/update a future tentative/confirmed drive with WB procedures populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISBLANK(sked_WB_Projected_Procedures__c) , sked_Is_Surrogate__c != TRUE, sked_Drive_Date__c >= today(), OR( ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, 'Tentative'), ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, 'Confirmed')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: WB Projected procedures is required, if drive is in Tentative or Confirmed status
